data.name: SJX Stims Addon for Consumables Galore
data.teaser: Welcome to SJX Stims Addon, a powerful expansion to the Consumables Galore mod.
data.description:
Overview

Dependency: Consumable Galore

Welcome to SJX Stims Addon, a powerful expansion to the Consumables Galore mod. This addon introduces a new tier of combat and utility stims based on existing EFT buff mechanics. Designed with balanced progression and late-game impact in mind, these stims offer:

  • New stimulant injectors with lore-friendly mixtures and effects
  • All stims spawn in raid (via original item spawns)
  • Optional trader availability (mid-to-late game levels)
  • Optional crafting in Medstation Level 2 or 3
  • Unique mixtures of buffs and duffs, pricing, and descriptions

Currently Included Injectors:

  • SJX-1 Sprinter: Stamina and mobility booster
  • SJX-2 Sharpshooter: Looting and perception enhancer
  • SJX-3 Berserker: PvP powerhouse stim
  • SJX-4 Fortifier: Advanced healing and sustain
  • SJX-5 Stealth: Counter-sniper and stealth entry stim

Use this alongside Consumables Galore for full compatibility and config support.

Setup, Config

Installation: Just drop the SJX Stims Addon folder into your spt directory with Consumables Galore — no extra configuration needed.

Each stim is defined in its own JSON file under user/mods/**Consumables Galore/**items/. You can:

  • Edit price, description, spawn weight
  • Enable/disable trader selling
  • Enable/disable crafting
  • Add or remove any stim by deleting its JSON file

Important: Make sure you don’t have a stim in your stash before deleting its file.

How to add your own stims

Follow the same format used in Consumables Galore. This mod reads from the items/ folder automatically.

Example SJX stim JSON includes:

  • cloneOrigin — base item ID (visuals, animations, sounds)
  • id — unique MongoID for your stim
  • fleaPrice / handBookPrice — flea and handbook prices
  • Buffs[] — the active effects
  • locales — name, shortName, and description
  • trader (optional) — which trader sells it, at what loyalty level
  • craft (optional) — crafting requirements and time

Use https://db.sp-tarkov.com/search/ to find item IDs for ingredients and origins.

All SJX stims are modeled after existing ones like Propital, AHF1-M, SJ6, 3-(b-TG), etc.

Credits and stuff

Big thanks to:

  • MusicManiac for the base mod Consumables Galore
  • RainbowPC for loot digging logic from Lots of Loot
  • papershredder432 for stim ideas from More Stim Injectors
  • Riisn for bulk item contributions

This addon made by AMightyTank, expanding EFT’s stim ecosystem.

If you enjoy this, support the original author or mod creators who made this possible!

versions.description:
# Changelog

## v1.0.2

**Now a Consumables Galore addon mod** - SJX-Stims is no longer a set of loose `.json`
files dropped into Consumables Galore's own `items/` folder. It's now its own compiled
SPT mod that registers through Consumables Galore's `LoadAdditionalItems` extension
point.

**Requires Consumables Galore v3.0.0+ and SPT ~4.1.1** - install Consumables Galore
first; SJX-Stims will not load without it.

### Changed

- Packaged as a standalone mod (`AlmightyTank-SJXStims.dll`) instead of raw item files
- Item definitions moved to this mod's own `items/` folder (same file contents, no
  balance/stat changes)
Fixed the naming problem in the file structure

versions.description:
Changelog

v3.0.0

SPT 4.1 compatibility - updated server and client for SPT 4.1.x Not backward compatible - this version requires SPT 4.1.x and will not work with SPT 4.0.x or earlier.

New

  • Quest-assort and quest-reward hookups:
    • includeInQuestAssortAsOrigin - mirrors whatever quest already locks the origin item’s trader assortment onto the new item
    • includeInQuestRewardsAsOrigin - mirrors any quest reward that gives the origin item onto the new item
    • trader.questUnlock - locks the new item’s assortment entry behind a specific quest, independent of the origin
    • questReward - gives the new item as a reward on a specific quest, independent of the origin
    • Quest-assort locks now also add a matching AssortmentUnlock reward, so the quest correctly displays “unlocks trader assortment” in-game instead of only working mechanically
  • LoadAdditionalItems extension point - other mods can now register their own item folders (including nested paths like db/CustomItems/Consumables) to be loaded through Consumables Galore’s full pipeline (clone, buffs, trader, quest hookups, spawns), without editing this mod
